FYI: today at 2024-02-14T13:00:00-05:00 @Sébastien Gouëzel will speak in the Rutgers Lean seminar. (Same zoom link as Yury's talk, or DM me for the link.)

Title: Formalizing the change of variables formula for integrals in mathlib

Abstract: We report on a formalization of the change of variables formula in
integrals, in the mathlib library for Lean. Our version of this theorem is
extremely general, and builds on developments in linear algebra, analysis,
measure theory and descriptive set theory. This is made possible by the
highly integrated development model of mathlib.
